ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.2 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a large contiguous white region with black mottling concentrated at the proximal base and along the trailing edge. The right lobe is predominantly black with a significant white geometric patch at the distal-trailing margin and a sparse field of small white circular blobs scattered across the central black region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees between the interior lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serration across both lobes with peak-to-valley heights of 5-15 pixels. Extreme high-amplitude topographical irregularity is present at both distal tips due to protruding three-dimensional calcified structures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a general convex curve from the notch to the distal tips, with a localized concave inflection point just proximal to the right lobe tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 24 distinct, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter) distributed across the dark field of the right lobe and central peduncle region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, dark-grey unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the white distal patch of the right lobe, ranging from 40 to 110 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) forming dense, high-contrast clusters at the distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'constellation' pattern of white focal spots against the black background of the right lobe, providing a specific coordinate-based identifier.
